name: Your Company
tagline: A coffee bar of signature drinks

listing.description: A site for a premium coffee bar, cocktail lounge or chef-driven restaurant. Living silk on the first screen, a drinks list with photos that follow the cursor, a dark elegant palette.

seo.title: Your Company — signature coffee bar in Tashkent
seo.description: Signature alcohol-free coffee cocktails, espresso tonics and cold brew at 45 Babur St. A dark room, a 12-seat bar and a five-drink tasting flight.
seo.answer: Your Company is a coffee bar at 45 Babur St in Tashkent, open from 10 am to midnight and till 1 am on Fridays and weekends. Signature drinks cost 42,000–58,000 UZS, an espresso tonic 39,000 UZS and a five-drink tasting flight 160,000 UZS. No alcohol is served.

sections.title: Coffee that tastes
sections.subtitle: Twelve seats at the bar, low light and drinks you won’t find on other menus. The barista builds you an evening of five cups — no alcohol, all aftertaste.

sections.label: The bar
sections.title: Coffee as a cocktail: precise, cold, with character
sections.text: Your Company was opened by baristas who had won city championships and grew tired of syrup lattes. Every drink is built in front of you, ice is cracked by hand, and we make our own syrups and infusions. No laptops, no loud music — just the bar, conversation and taste.

items.title: Black Pearl
items.text: Bitter, fresh, with a piney nose.

items.title: Velvet
items.text: Soft and dense, like a sugar-free dessert.

items.title: Pomegranate Garden
items.text: Uzbek pomegranate and Ethiopian coffee in one glass.

items.title: Smoke
items.text: Served under a cloche of cherry-wood smoke.

items.title: Night flight
items.text: An hour-long tasting with the story of each bean.

sections.label: Contact
